changes.problem: 读响应data的0..4096范围超出实际codec范围，并允许空数据。
changes.resolution: 位读响应改为1..250字节，寄存器读改为2..250字节；偶数与跨请求数量关系的执行边界分别注明。

changes.problem: 一个宽function异常模型只关联FC03，却被描述为覆盖所有函数。
changes.resolution: 保留exception作为固定0x83的FC03模型，新增其余七类函数的固定异常function响应及对应transaction/unit依赖和状态边；FC0F partial复用canonical-equivalent请求的异常。

changes.problem: 响应transaction/unit字段标为普通fuzzable，未准确表达现场请求缓存关联。
changes.resolution: 所有已有copy/correlate响应目标明确标为runtime_bound，不改变已知codec功能。

changes.problem: 读数量与响应长度、末字节位填充的关系只存在于说明中。
changes.resolution: protocol_session_constraints.c 在实际已提交请求与已验证响应之间执行数量方程、位填充、function/transaction/unit 与写回显检查；准备/取消使用会话快照，拒绝响应不消耗 pending。

codec_constraints.constraint: Every message has a 7-byte MBAP prefix: protocol ID=0; encoded length equals complete ADU bytes minus6; native codec limits ADU to8..260 bytes. Reviewed abs fields cover every example byte.
Read requests have12 bytes; FC01/02 quantity1..2000 and FC03/04 quantity1..125. Function is fixed per message.
FC05/06 requests have12 bytes. FC05 value is exactly0000 orFF00 by codec validation; values is only a suggestion pool. FC06 value is a complete UInt16.

FC0F quantity1..1968, byte_count=ceil(quantity/8), unused final high bits zero. FC10 quantity1..123, byte_count=2*quantity. Variable data1..246(coils) or2..246(registers) and MBAP length are repaired by codec.

Normal read responses have native byte_count/data agreement; bits data1..250 and registers data2..250 with even byte count. Model correlations compare transaction/unit with the cached live request; the separate MB-LIVE-TRANSACTION executor check enforces the quantity equation and final coil padding.
Normal write acknowledgements contain no request data/byte_count extension; transaction, unit, address and value/quantity echo their corresponding live request fields.

Every exception ADU has9 bytes, one fixed request-specific function|80 field and one codec-accepted exception code in01,02,03,04,05,06,08,0A,0B. Transaction/unit correlation links the declared request; FC0F partial shares write_coils canonical identity.

The executor keeps one submitted request. Responses must match transaction, unit and function; exception function is request.function|0x80. FC01/02 length=ceil(quantity/8), with all unused final high bits zero; FC03/04 length=2*quantity. FC05/06 echo address/value and FC0F/10 echo address/quantity. Refused responses preserve pending state; canceled preparation does not advance the live session.

remaining_gaps.description: This profile covers FC01/02/03/04/05/06/0F/10 only. File records, mask write, combined read/write, FIFO, MEI/device identification and serial-specific services are not described.
remaining_gaps.resolution: Add separately sourced field layouts, service semantics, codec support and request/response state contracts before claiming those function families.

remaining_gaps.description: Address-plus-quantity overflow and device mapping availability are not encoded as executable model constraints.
remaining_gaps.resolution: Add explicit supported address-span constraints if valid-only generation must exclude requests requiring server illegal-address exceptions.

remaining_gaps.description: Current legacy runtime permits one outstanding request per session; transaction IDs are not a general concurrent transaction database.
remaining_gaps.resolution: Keep experiments serial or implement transaction-keyed caches and pending response alternatives in the runtime.

remaining_gaps.description: Published protocols/modbus_tcp/generic_wire.json remains a two-message FC03 one-register online subset. The extended generic executor has a separate 24-grammar full_modbus regression fixture covering the eight function families and normal/exception alternatives; that fixture is not this reviewed 26-message package or its published replacement.
remaining_gaps.resolution: Keep the published coverage inventory exact. Promote a full generic package only after defining its aliases, source mapping and managed corpus, and recording native and controlled-target evidence for that exact package.

remaining_gaps.description: This directory remains editable source and carries no generated validation result. Native preparation, C/sanitizer regressions and controlled local execution were run separately during the executor extension; those results do not establish independent device interoperability or fixed-budget method effectiveness.
remaining_gaps.resolution: Use docs/executor-extension-20261104.zh-CN.md and its exact output paths for current run results. Keep new IR/corpus/results outside this source catalog; add independent target and fixed-budget comparison evidence before making broader effectiveness claims.
